headline: UK Renewable Energy Expansion Constrained by Power Grid Bottlenecks
summary: Heavy investment in UK renewable power faces major grid transmission bottlenecks, leaving the country dependent on natural gas despite substantial new wind and solar capacity.
why: Inadequate transmission infrastructure can restrict green power delivery, inflate grid-balancing costs, and complicate decarbonization pathways for power utilities.

impacts.name: Renewable Utilities
impacts.why: Grid congestion limits the commercial transmission and dispatch of electricity from new wind and solar projects.

impacts.name: Natural Gas
impacts.why: Transmission limitations for renewables sustain reliance on gas-fired generation for electricity stability.
